newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mikuni assigns preliminary bond credit ratings.
newsitem.headline: Mikuni assigns preliminary bond credit ratings.

text.p: Mikuni and Co Ltd said on Friday it had assigned the following preliminary ratings to planned bond issues:
-AAA-
Keiyo Co Ltd, $100 million unsecured due 2002, private placement, guuaranteed by Bank of Tokyo Mitsubishi.
Toa Corp, 50 million Swiss Francs unsecured with warrants due 2001,, private placement, guaranteed by Bank of Tokyo Mitsubishi.
-AA-
The Chugoku Electric Power Co Inc, 50 billion yen mortgaged due 20177.
Keihan Electric Railway Co Ltd, 10 billion yen unsecured due 2007.
The Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc, 100 billion yen mortgaged due 2007.. 50 billion yen mortgaged due 2017.
Kotobukiya Co Ltd, 70 million Swiss Francs unsecured due 2002, privvate placement, guaranteed by Industrial Bank of Japan.
-BBB-
Daiwa Kosho Lease Co Ltd, 20 billion yen unsecured convertible due 22001, private placement.
Sigma Koki Co Ltd, 30 million Swiss Francs unsecured with warrants ddue 2001, private placement, guaranteed by Asahi Bank.
-BB-
Hitachi Transport System Ltd, 10 billion yen unsecured due 2002.
Mitsui Petrochemical Ind Ltd, 10 billion yen unsecured due 2002.
-CCC-
Daio Paper Corp, 10 billion yen unsecured due 2004.
Kohnan Shoji Co Ltd, five billion yen unsecured convertible due 2004.
